intro: Stay comfortable, stay productive. With high resilience foam, adjustable height and flexible support, the Learn chair is built to move with you—so you can focus on work, not your posture.

features.title: The right recline support for you
features.text: The 360° swivel and tilting mechanism with adjustable tension help you move naturally while providing steady back support—keeping you active without sacrificing comfort.

features.title: Comfortable foam seat and back
features.text: The seat and back is made up of injection moulded glass with high quality PU foam for ultimate seating experience. It embodies the players who cant wait to get comfortable at the top.

features.title: Recline with ease, no surprises
features.text: Lean back without resistance. The tilt mechanism adjusts effortlessly as per your needs, giving you smooth support with no sudden pushback.

features.title: Mobility when you need it
features.text: Smooth castors let you move effortlessly between tasks, with stability and floor-friendly movement built in.

features.title: Compact comfort, big impact
features.text: Small in size, big on convenience—this compact chair is ready to adapt to your space while keeping you comfortable.

name: Learn Fabric Adjustble Height Revolving Study Chair Set Milan Red Set Of 5
